name: Postscript of Love
original_name: 给你的第三封信是遗言
overview:
Shen Jia Rui has caught her husband and only love Gu Wen Yan cheating a total of 99 times. He always said that he would make her regret marrying him. But now, as the countdown to her death looms, she is determined to make him regret it instead.

(Source: MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gei Ni De Di San Feng Xin Shi Yi Yan" (给你的第三封信是遗言) by Cao Mei Chun Juan (草莓春卷).
